The '''''Night Wind''''' was a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] crewed by a band of pirates led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jor Entel]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Prior to the [[Demophon supernova]] Jor Entel offered the ''Night Wind'' as an inexpensive means of evacuating [[Demophon]]. In reality he was slaughtering the refugees he ferried and stealing their valuables.<ref name="BE" />
